**Finding: Compliant** (rule IP — Ownership of deliverables and Customer Data)

The document's IP package sits at the **preferred** position, so no redline was proposed:

- **§14.1** — Customer owns all Customer Data, Customer Confidential Information and independently developed IP; Vendor gets only a limited processing right. Reinforced by **§15.1** (no sale, advertising, commingling, or model training without consent).
- **§14.2** — Customer owns each Deliverable on creation, with a present assignment from Vendor, flow-down assignments from personnel, and further assurances.
- **§14.3 + §13.2** — Vendor retains only its pre-existing Vendor Technology, and any embedded Vendor Technology carries a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid licence to use, modify and create derivative works for Customer's business.
- **§14.4** — No joint ownership absent a signed instrument; feedback use is anonymised and Customer keeps unrestricted rights in its own feedback.

Noted but not flagged: Deliverable ownership is conditioned on payment of Fees, and §13.2 permits contractor support/derivative works rather than expressly saying "sublicense." These are minor sub-elements, not material failures.
